description: Window chrome, one global shortcut, and one argument-less screen-capture command. No filesystem, shell or HTTP permissions are granted to the webview — every capability goes through the backend, where .conca can see it. The capture command returns bytes rather than a filename precisely so that granting it does not also grant a path. `withGlobalTauri` in tauri.conf.json exposes the IPC bridge to the webview so the overlay can invoke without an npm dependency; the bridge only reaches commands registered in main.rs and permitted here, so widening it is still a two-file, reviewable edit.
